records.title: 1465年：Ramnath摄政的叙述终点
records.description: 理念称1430年代自Jiantsiang来的Ramnath在1443疫病后为女儿Shushuri统治Keyattordha，直到1465死亡；政治影响在于Ascendant Soul学派在城内扎根。 此为已封存MOD理念的有年叙述，证据等级保持单一游戏文本；不自动修改政权、疆界或宗属。 本地旧年表有相同或相近叙述；可能共用编纂上游，不计为已证明独立旁证。

dateEvidence.precision: explicit year in MOD narrative / diegetic quotation
dateEvidence.quote: Keyattordha is the only place in Rahen where the eastern philosophy of the Ascendant Soul holds sway. Ramnath of the Undying Flame, prince of Jiantsiang, brought the teachings with him in the 1430s when he traveled to Keyattordha to marry the sister of lord Jawaral Bloody Claw. A charming personality, Ramnath quickly became beloved by the nobles and commoners of Keyattordha alike. When members of the court began to engage the eastern prince about philosophy they found his exotic views intriguing, and a small following of the Ascendent Soul began to grow.\n\nWhen plague struck Keyattordha in 1443, it claimed Ramnath's wife and brother-in-law, leaving the only surviving member of the Bloody Claw family as Ramnath’s infant daughter Shushuri. The people turned to Ramnath, who readily stepped into power and ruled Keyattordha for his daughter until his death in 1465. His tenure as Prabhi cemented his personal fame, and solidified the Ascendant Soul school's dominance in the city.
